_doc: ISOLATION SCOPES THE MARQUEE (G11 step 4; seat design 2026-11-08 g11-marquee-scope).
`select_rect` carries `root` (the innermost isolation entry) ONLY while isolated, so
every case recorded outside isolation has no key and is unchanged. With a root the
units are that container's children: a member answers for itself, a group inside the
root answers alone (section 16.4), and a band outside the root selects nothing.
THE DOCUMENT (SVG px -> pt is x3/4):
No transformed group here: the reference's flat walk takes no parent frame, so
the frame arms live in each port's own tests, not in this shared family.
Inside the root a band over r1 selects r1 [0,0,0]. a post-filter of the layer walk answers nothing: the layer walk returns g [0,0], which is not under the root.
name: a_member_inside_the_root_answers_for_itself

_doc: The defect this family exists for: a band over r3 [0,1] while g is isolated selected r3.
name: a_band_outside_the_root_selects_nothing

_doc: Section 16.4 one level down: a band over r5 answers s [0,0,2], never r5.
name: a_group_inside_the_root_answers_alone

_doc: The control: the same band as the first case with no root selects g [0,0], as before g11.
name: no_root_is_the_layer_walk
